title: Lean proof — bipedal F_3 correctness per D2 sketch
description:
Implement the Lean4 proof of bipedal $\mathbb{F}_3$ arithmetic correctness against the canonical `Fp<3>` field, per the approved D2 proof sketch.

## Background

D2's approved proof sketch (`a0c0a45f`) names the lemmas, the proof tactics, and the exact production code path the Charon-generated Lean definitions must be proved against. Per the verification-work conventions in CLAUDE.md, the sketch was approved before this issue was dispatched.

The proof targets `Bipedal3::add`, `Bipedal3::sub`, `Bipedal3::mul`, `Bipedal3::neg` against the canonical `Fp<3>` semantics (decoded lane-by-lane). It builds via the project's Charon $\to$ Aeneas $\to$ Lean4 pipeline (`scripts/verify-lean.sh`); the committed `proofs/` tree is under `Gf2Algebra/`.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `proofs/Gf2Algebra/Proofs/Bipedal3Correctness.lean` exists with the theorem statements named in the D2 sketch.
- [ ] [hard] `cd proofs && lake build` succeeds with no `sorry` in the new file.
- [ ] [hard] The proof is exercised against the actual Rust production code (not a copied stub), per the verification-work convention.
- [ ] [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh` regenerates the LLBC + Lean from current Rust source successfully.
- [ ] [hard] `lake-build` gate passes.
